responsibility: Checks function and closure bodies against their signatures by setting up return-type coercion, gathering locals, type-checking parameters and the body tail, enforcing `Sized` and well-formedness obligations on inputs and outputs, and validating special lang-item entry-point signatures such as `panic_impl` and `start`. It also handles type checking for child bodies such as closures and anonymous constants by registering well-formedness obligations for parameter types and return types, so closure arguments and closure returns containing unresolved inference variables are checked as part of body type checking rather than only surfacing later during deferred validations such as transmute checking.
